This template consists of <tt>&lt;div style="clear:both;"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</tt>

<nowiki>{{clear}}</nowiki> makes the following content start below all previous content in all columns. It can be used to stop text from flowing next to unrelated images or sidebars.

In addition, the first parameter can be used to override "both"; for example, {{<nowiki/>clear|left}} will force the following content to appear below floating content on the left side only. (See [http://www.w3schools.com/cssref/pr_class_clear.asp this page] for more information.)

==Use on creature pages==

This template can often prevent misaligned raw and creature boxes caused by the sidebar at the left of creature pages.

===Option 1, without <nowiki>{{clear}}</nowiki>===

{{creatureInfo v0.34|name=Animal 1}}
<div style="height: 25em;">
Text

Text

Text

Text
</div>
{{creatures}}


----


===Option 2, with <nowiki>{{clear}}</nowiki>===

{{creatureInfo v0.34|name=Animal 2}}
<div style="height: 25em;">
Text

Text

Text

Text
</div>
{{clear}}
{{creatures}}
